topology.p2p: localhost bootnode with the official seven-node private-network genesis

observations: Reth maintained seven protocol peers and followed the six-Geth validator chain through a restart.
The private genesis has no transaction-bearing blocks in the sampled window, so receipt-level execution comparison was exercised but checked zero transactions.
A full DKG epoch, prover-delay, replacement, and explicit view-change gate still requires the private DKG shares and external prover harness.
